build_prompt_encoder: build a PromptEncoder instance with embed_dim, image_embedding_size, input_image_size, and mask_in_chans parameters
embed_points: embed point prompts with coordinates and labels using the _embed_points method of PromptEncoder
embed_boxes: embed box prompts by passing a tensor of box coordinates to the _embed_boxes method
embed_masks: embed mask inputs by passing a mask tensor through the _embed_masks method of PromptEncoder
forward_prompt_encoder: run the PromptEncoder forward pass with points, boxes, and masks to get sparse and dense embeddings
